country.description: The country name or ISO2/ISO3 code to be used for identifying the number format. Defaults to None.

country_auto.description: Flag to auto-detect the country if not provided. Accepts values 0 (false), 1 (fast mode), and 2 (slow mode). Defaults to 0.

uid.description: User Identification for personalized response and response continuity.

annotation:
<tool_call>
{"name": "go", "arguments": {"txt": "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", "fix": 4, "lng": "es"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_call>
{"name": "extract", "arguments": {"text": "Call me at 555-1234 or 555-5678."}}
</tool_call>
model_answer:
<tool_call>
{"name": "go", "arguments": {"txt": "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", "fix": 4, "lng": "es", "model": "m1"}}
</tool_call>
<tool_call>
{"name": "extract", "arguments": {"text": "Call me at 555-1234 or 555-5678.", "country": null, "country_auto": 0}}
</tool_call>
